name: Rocket Bites - 200mg Edible Gummies - Lemonade Galaxy
description:
Big flavor in a small bite. Rocket Bites Lemonade Galaxy gummies deliver bright, zesty lemonade taste — sweet, tart, and refreshing in every piece.

Made with a sativa profile for an uplifting, energizing feel, these are a great pick for daytime. Each pack contains 10 gummies at 20mg each — 200mg total — so it's easy to dial in exactly the dose you want.

10 gummies × 20mg — 200mg per pack
Zesty Lemonade Galaxy flavor — sweet, tart, and refreshing
Sativa — uplifting and energizing, ideal for daytime
Easy to portion — consistent dosing in every piece

Start low, go slow, and enjoy the ride.
